h1:
Where to Stay in Ang Thong?
12 Stays We Actually Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites!
heroSub: 12 hand-picked Ang Thong stays across every budget — from the newly opened Suphorn Grand in town and the Japanese-style IKKYU2 boutique down to a rice-field homestay overlooking the Wat Muang Big Buddha from ฿300/night. Covering the main areas: in-town Ang Thong, the canal-side city edge, and the Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan area. From roughly ฿300–950/night.
heroStats: 📍 3 key areas (In Town·Canal-Side Edge·Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan)
introH2: 📍 Why does choosing the right area in Ang Thong matter?
introHtml: Ang Thong is a small province with no big hotel chains and no metro — most stays are small resorts, boutiques and owner-run homestays, so your choice of area clearly shapes the trip. In-town Ang Thong (the Talat Luang–Ban It–Phosa area) is the hub for restaurants, markets, 7-Eleven and the hospital — ideal for exploring the town, eating your way around, or using Ang Thong as a base for its temples, and walkable even without a car. The canal-side city edge (Phosa–Pa Ngio–Sala Daeng) is where the quiet garden resorts and bungalows sit — only minutes from town, but you'll want a car. And the Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan area, about 15–20 km out of town, sits closer to the Wat Muang Big Buddha and Sala Chao Rong Thong — best if paying respects and photographing the giant Buddha is your main goal. Many people book outside town without a car, then struggle to get around because shops and public transport are thin. This guide rounds up 12 Ang Thong stays we've already reviewed across every tier — with real guest-review scores, a 3-site price comparison and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Ang Thong has no metro and limited in-town public transport; you get around mainly by private or rental car, and the province is small enough that your choice of area sets up the whole trip. Stays in town (Talat Luang–Ban It–Phosa) are the easiest, with restaurants, markets, 7-Eleven and the hospital nearby — manageable even without a car. Stays on the canal-side city edge (Phosa–Pa Ngio–Sala Daeng) are quiet garden resorts a few minutes' drive from town, but dining around them is thin, so a car helps. Almost everything in the Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan area needs a car, as it's 15–20 km out of town near the Big Buddha. The areas in this guide: In Town — restaurants, markets, easy to get around · Canal-Side Edge — quiet garden resorts · Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan — base for the Big Buddha.

entries.name: Suphorn Grand Hotel
entries.badge: 🏆 Top score · new rooms in town
tags: 🏙️ In-town location, easy to get around
entries.addr: 42 Moo 11, Ban It, Mueang Ang Thong
entries.storyHtml: Suphorn Grand Hotel is the top score in this guide at 9.3 — a 3-star hotel that opened in 2023 in central Ang Thong, with a new building and rooms and furniture that still feel fresh and clean. Real guest reviews praise the clean new rooms, friendly and helpful staff, spacious easy parking and a convenient in-town location. As a recently opened hotel it does still have a few kinks — reviewers mention the hot water needs a staff member to switch it on first, and a faint paint smell in some corridors. Best for travellers who want a clean, new room in town for a reasonable price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: As a brand-new hotel the rooms punch above their price — a comfortable base for touring the province's temples. Some rooms' hot water needs staff to flip a switch first, so flag it at check-in. No free slippers, so bring your own or buy a pair at the hotel.
pros: Top score 9.3 · opened 2023, new clean rooms and furniture
In-town Ang Thong location, easy to get around, great base
Friendly, helpful staff with good local info
Spacious, easy parking · breakfast available
cons: Hot water in some rooms needs staff to switch on first
Recently opened, faint paint smell in some corridors · no free slippers

entries.name: IKKYU2 Ang Thong
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.0 · 29 reviews (most in the boutique group)
entries.addr: 71/47 Liang Mueang Rd, Phosa, Mueang Ang Thong
entries.storyHtml: IKKYU2 Ang Thong is a small Japanese-style boutique stay scoring 9.0 from 29 reviews — the most reviews in the boutique group in this guide. It sits in Phosa in central Ang Thong. Real guest reviews praise the clean, tidy, quiet rooms that are better value and roomier than expected, in-room Netflix, a private balcony, and friendly staff who speak several languages. But it's a small property — reviewers note you can hear footsteps in the corridor, there's no breakfast so you head out to eat, and the convenience store is too far to walk. Best for travellers who want a clean, quiet, private room in town for a reasonable price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Rooms are limited and prices climb on holidays and busy spells, so book ahead and lock in the rate. No breakfast — drive out to a place in town or stock up first. Ask for a room away from the corridor if you're a light sleeper.
pros: Score 9.0 · most reviews in the boutique group, 29
Clean, tidy, quiet rooms, great value and roomier than expected
In-room Netflix and a private balcony
Friendly multilingual staff · free parking
cons: You can hear footsteps in the corridor · no breakfast
Convenience store too far to walk, you'll want a car

entries.name: Hor Nok Hook Resort Ang Thong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chaiyo sub-district · Chaiyo district · out of town
tags: 🛏️ Every room has a private balcony
entries.storyHtml: Hor Nok Hook Resort is a small 15-room resort in the Chaiyo countryside scoring 8.3 from 25 reviews — strong on quiet and a genuine getaway feel. Real guest reviews praise how peaceful it is, away from noise, with clean rooms, cold air-con, comfortable beds and strong Wi-Fi, attentive owners and staff, and a large garden with a picnic and barbecue area. But the countryside location means no restaurants or convenience stores nearby — you drive out — there's no breakfast (drinks only), and facilities are basic with no pool. Best for self-drivers who want a quiet stay at a light price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Driving yourself is easiest, with free parking; the countryside spot has no shops next door, so bring food or plan a place in town first. Pets welcome (about +50 baht/night). Use the big garden for a picnic or barbecue with friends.
pros: Score 8.3 · very quiet, a genuine getaway
Clean rooms, cold air-con, comfy beds, strong Wi-Fi
Every room has a private balcony · large garden with picnic/BBQ area
Pet-friendly · free parking · attentive owners
cons: No breakfast, drinks only · no pool
Countryside spot, no restaurants/convenience stores nearby, you drive out

entries.name: Blue House Ang Thong
entries.addr: 44 Rim Khlong Chonprathan Rd, Talat Luang, Mueang Ang Thong
entries.storyHtml: Blue House Ang Thong is a small 14-room owner-run boutique in town — light on the wallet and likeable, walkable to restaurants and markets. Score 8.1 from 9 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the clean rooms, good water pressure, comfortable sleep, gracious and helpful owners and staff, morning coffee and bread, and free parking. But it's a small boutique with few reviews so far, somewhat scattered scores and standards that may not be fully consistent — some reviews mention tiny ants in room corners — and it's mostly cash payment. Best for budget travellers who want a clean room in town; check the latest reviews and bring cash.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Mostly cash payment, so bring enough. In-town location is walkable to restaurants and markets, manageable without a car. Message the owner first if you need to check in outside normal hours.
pros: Clean rooms, good water pressure, comfortable sleep
Gracious, helpful owners and staff
In-town location, walk to restaurants and markets
Morning coffee & bread · free Wi-Fi · free parking · good value
cons: Few real reviews so far, scattered scores, standards may vary

entries.name: Jumbo Villa Resort Ang Thong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sala Chao Rong Thong, Wiset Chai Chan · near Wat Muang
entries.addr: 4 Moo 7, Sala Chao Rong Thong, Wiset Chai Chan District
entries.storyHtml: Jumbo Villa Resort is an owner-run homestay-resort with garden rooms in the Wiset Chai Chan countryside near Wat Muang, opened in 2023 so the rooms still feel new. Score 8.1 from 16 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the clean, new single-storey garden rooms, total quiet at night, a private countryside feel, free bikes to borrow, free parking right outside the room, and a friendly, attentive owner. But facilities are just-enough — no restaurant or pool — the front desk isn't 24 hours, and the countryside location needs a car. Best for self-drivers who want a quiet garden room near Wat Muang in the ฿600 range.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The front desk isn't open 24 hours, so tell the owner your check-in time ahead. Borrow the free bikes for a ride around the countryside. Makes an easy base to drive to the Wat Muang Big Buddha and Sala Chao Rong Thong.
pros: Clean, new single-storey garden rooms, opened 2023
Total quiet at night, private countryside feel

entries.name: Wiset Sabai Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sala Chao Rong Thong, Wiset Chai Chan · near Wat Muang
entries.addr: 12/56 Moo 7, Wiset Chai Chan–Pa Mok Rd, Sala Chao Rong Thong, Wiset Chai Chan District
entries.storyHtml: Wiset Sabai Resort is a single-storey garden-bungalow resort in the Wiset Chai Chan area near Wat Muang, with new, clean rooms (opened 2022). Score 8.1 from 13 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the standalone bungalows that are quiet and private, the new clean rooms with cold air-con, friendly owners and staff who look after you like family, free parking right outside the room, and pet-friendliness. But some bungalows are windowless rooms, there's no in-house breakfast (you head out to eat), and it's in the Wiset Chai Chan area rather than the town centre, so a car helps. Best for self-drivers who want a quiet garden bungalow near Wat Muang in the ฿700 range.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Some bungalows are windowless — if you want natural light, ask for a room with a window or a Standard Double when you book. An easy base to drive to the Wat Muang Big Buddha. No in-house breakfast, so plan a place in the area first.

New, clean rooms, cold air-con (opened 2022)
Friendly owners and staff who look after you like family
Near Wat Muang · pet-friendly · free parking
cons: Some bungalows are windowless rooms · no in-house breakfast

entries.name: Mor Mor Resort Ang Thong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pa Ngio · Mueang Ang Thong · near Highway 4017
entries.addr: 39 Moo 6, Pa Ngio, Mueang Ang Thong
entries.storyHtml: Mor Mor Resort is a garden bungalow resort with rice-field views in the Pa Ngio area, where you wake to paddy fields and breakfast is available. Score 8.0 from 6 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the quiet, private garden bungalows with rice-field views, clean spacious rooms with comfortable beds, breakfast for guests, friendly attentive owners, and a fish pond with a sala to relax in. But facilities are basic with no pool or gym, there are only 4 units so they fill fast on holidays, and the countryside location has limited shops within walking distance. Best for travellers who want to sleep close to nature, wake to rice fields and have breakfast, in the high-hundreds range.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Only 4 units fill fast on holidays — call to book directly ahead. Choose the room-with-breakfast option (฿990) if you want it all in one place. Driving yourself is easiest as the countryside spot has limited shops.

entries.name: Baan Thung Ratchawan Homestay & Resort
entries.revCount: Not yet on major booking sites · book direct with the owner

entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pho Rang Nok, Pho Thong · near Wat Muang
tags: 🌾 In the rice fields, Big Buddha view
🌙 Dinner under the stars, local food
entries.addr: 11/1 Pho Rang Nok, Pho Thong District (near Wat Muang, Wiset Chai Chan)
entries.storyHtml: Baan Thung Ratchawan is the cheapest stay in this guide, from ฿300 (tents from ฿150) — a rice-field homestay whose draw is sleeping out in the paddies, the Wat Muang Big Buddha in view, and dinner under the stars. Real guest reviews praise the open rice-field setting overlooking the giant Buddha, dinner under the stars with renowned local dishes like Ratchawan braised pork leg, a range of houses and tents from the low hundreds, morning coffee, and how well it suits groups of friends and families. But it's not yet on major booking sites, has no review score to check, and must be booked direct via Facebook/LINE/phone (likely cash), and there's karaoke and live music at night. Best for travellers who want a budget rice-field sleepover; message the owner to confirm details first.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Not yet on major booking sites — book direct via Facebook/LINE/phone and bring cash. There's karaoke and live music at night, so if you want quiet, ask the owner about event nights first. Pre-order dinner under the stars with the owner and try the renowned Ratchawan braised pork leg.
pros: Open rice-field setting overlooking the Wat Muang Big Buddha
Dinner under the stars, renowned local dishes (Ratchawan pork leg)
Range of houses and tents, from ฿150 · morning coffee

entries.name: Bualuang Hotel Ang Thong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ayutthaya–Ang Thong Rd · Phosa · in town
entries.addr: 15/1 Ayutthaya–Ang Thong Rd, Phosa, Mueang Ang Thong
entries.storyHtml: Bualuang Hotel Ang Thong is the most-reviewed stay in this guide — 33 reviews — a 3-star in town with standalone garden rooms that are quiet, park right outside, and pet-friendly. Score 7.7. Real guest reviews praise the standalone garden rooms that are quiet and private, the in-town location near 7-Eleven, the hospital and the Chao Phraya River, friendly helpful staff, pet-friendliness, and a friendly from-price. But reviews are honest that room condition is uneven — the older zone shows its age, with faded curtains and older furniture, some bathrooms have weak flow or uneven cleaning, and there are few power outlets. Best for travellers who want a quiet standalone room with easy parking and pets allowed in the high-hundreds; ask for a room in the newer zone when you book.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: There are older and newer room zones in different condition — ask for the newer zone at booking and inspect the room before accepting. Few power outlets in the room, so bring a power strip. In-town location near 7-Eleven and the hospital, convenient even without a car.

entries.storyHtml: Rimchon Resort Ang Thong is an 8-room single-storey garden bungalow resort in the Sala Daeng area that's quiet, easy to park at and in the high-hundreds, near the bus station and Lotus. Score 7.6 from 5 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the quiet, private single-storey garden bungalows where you park right outside, the clean and genuinely usable rooms with bright, pleasant décor, the friendly, approachable owners and staff, and good value-for-money scores. But facilities are basic with no pool/gym/in-house restaurant, there are only 8 rooms so they fill fast on holidays, and shops within walking distance are limited so you drive. Best for travellers who want a quiet bungalow with easy parking in the high-hundreds.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Only 8 rooms fill fast on holidays — call to book directly ahead. Near the bus station and Lotus, handy for shopping and onward transport. Driving yourself is easiest as shops within walking distance are limited.

entries.name: Bualuang Boutique Resort
entries.addr: 66 Liab Khlong Chonprathan Rd, Phosa, Mueang Ang Thong
entries.storyHtml: Bualuang Boutique Resort is a single-storey garden boutique resort on the canal-side city edge, with spacious clean rooms and an in-house minimart. Score 7.5 from 17 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the nicely sized single-storey garden rooms that are quiet and private, cleanliness that scores especially high, free parking right outside the room, usable strong Wi-Fi, and an in-house minimart for easy shopping. But the bathroom is the sticking point several reviews flag — weak hot water and low shower pressure — the beds and pillows are fairly firm for some, and the city-edge location has a fairly deep entrance lane so you need a car. Best for self-drivers who want a quiet, spacious, clean garden room in the ฿600 range.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The bathroom's hot water is weak and shower pressure low, so set expectations. Beds and pillows are fairly firm — ask for an extra pillow if you sleep poorly. The entrance lane is fairly deep, so use accurate GPS, especially the first time.

entries.badge: 🚗 Park at your door · has a restaurant

entries.storyHtml: Ratchapruek DC Resort is a small 10-room single-storey resort in the Pa Ngio city-edge area, where you park right outside the room, there's an in-resort restaurant, and it's about a 5-minute drive into town and to the river. Score 7.5 from 16 reviews. Real guest reviews praise the single-storey rooms where you park at your door (handy for self-drivers), the small, quiet, private resort, the roughly 5-minute drive to the town centre and the Chao Phraya River, and the in-resort restaurant. But real reviews are still few, scores are scattered across platforms and standards may vary, it's not a walking-around location with limited shops nearby, and facilities are basic with no pool/gym. Best for self-drivers who want a quiet single-storey room with park-at-your-door access on a light budget; confirm your check-in time first.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm your check-in time with the resort first, since it's small. Park right at your door, handy for self-drivers, with a ~5-minute drive into town. There's an in-resort restaurant, but plan a place in town if you're staying several nights.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Ang Thong stays

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in in Ang Thong?
faq.a: It depends on your trip's goal · In-town Ang Thong (Talat Luang–Ban It–Phosa) has restaurants, markets, 7-Eleven and the hospital, and is easy to get around even without a car (Suphorn Grand, IKKYU2, Blue House, Bualuang Hotel) · The canal-side city edge is quiet garden resorts a few minutes' drive from town, but you'll want a car (Bualuang Boutique, Ratchapruek DC, Rimchon, Mor Mor) · The Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan area is closer to the Big Buddha than the town centre, best for temple visits (Jumbo Villa, Wiset Sabai, Baan Thung Ratchawan)

faq.q: ❓ How much do Ang Thong stays cost?
faq.a: Very light compared with tourist cities: homestays and budget stays start around ฿300–600 per night (Baan Thung Ratchawan, Bualuang Hotel, Hor Nok Hook, Jumbo Villa) · resorts and in-town hotels are around ฿650–950 (IKKYU2, Blue House, Wiset Sabai, Mor Mor, Suphorn Grand) · all prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and can climb during long weekends and festivals.

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay to visit the Wat Muang Big Buddha?
faq.a: The Wat Muang Big Buddha is over in Wiset Chai Chan district, about 15–20 km from central Ang Thong · if visiting the Buddha is your main goal, staying in the Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan area cuts the driving — Jumbo Villa Resort ฿600 garden rooms with free bikes, Wiset Sabai Resort ฿700 garden bungalows with new rooms, or Baan Thung Ratchawan ฿300 a rice-field homestay where you see the giant Buddha right from the stay · all need a car as they're out of town.

faq.q: ❓ Is Ang Thong easy to get around without a car?
faq.a: Ang Thong has no metro and limited in-town public transport, so without a car staying in central Ang Thong is easiest — Suphorn Grand, IKKYU2, Blue House and Bualuang Hotel are in town, walkable to restaurants and 7-Eleven · the city-edge resorts and the Wat Muang–Wiset Chai Chan area have few shops nearby, so a private or rental car is recommended, especially to tour the province's temples.

faq.q: ❓ Some Ang Thong stays aren't on booking sites — how do I book?
faq.a: Ang Thong has several small resorts and homestays that aren't on major booking sites yet or have few reviews, such as Baan Thung Ratchawan (book direct via Facebook/LINE/phone) and Mor Mor/Rimchon (call to book directly ahead) · these stays usually take cash, so bring cash and confirm availability before you travel · for stays that are on booking sites, compare 3 sites before booking.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Ang Thong stays?
faq.a: Prices vary across each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) by promotion and season, so always open and compare all 3 before booking — each review page in this guide has full price-comparison links that can save money, especially during long weekends and festivals when stays in a small province like Ang Thong fill fast.
